summary: Verified fossa removal and Instagram fallback path. Backend 3/3 tests pass (root, /api/instagram/feed configured=false, /api/reviews configured=false). Frontend: exactly 7 service cards (no 'Limpeza de Fossa'), footer contains no 'Fossa', gallery falls back to gallery-static with 5 items, gallery-instagram-link present and points to client's Instagram, lightbox next/prev/close/ESC all work. No console errors. /api/instagram/feed returns 200 with {configured:false, items:[], cached:false}.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: server.py _get_ig_token seeds a token doc even when INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN is empty is prevented because instagram_feed early-returns configured=false first, so no issue in practice.
Consider: Gallery.js has a race — when live is true but items empty, gridClass switches but static fallback used; currently guarded by items.length>0 check, OK.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Instagram token intentionally empty. To test live path in future, populate INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN and INSTAGRAM_USER_ID in /app/backend/.env and restart backend; then gallery-live should replace gallery-static.
